summary: Solve an RL circuit with source v(t) and initial current I0 using Laplace transform to find i(t), evaluate for a step input with R=10Ω, L=5H, I0=3A; also phasor analysis of an AC circuit (voltages and currents) and Thevenin equivalent of a resistive network with 32V and 2A sources to find load current for RL=6,16,36Ω.
